title: LA County Autopsy Report (Case 2023-14789)
description: Los Angeles County Department of Medical Examiner autopsy report. Tailored to this specific case.

jurisdiction.description: Issuing medical examiner / coroner office as printed in the header.

case_number.description: Case number as printed on the report.

decedent_name.description: Decedent's full name (last, first middle) as recorded on the report. Null if redacted.

date_of_death.description: Date the decedent was pronounced dead.

heart_weight_grams.description: Recorded heart weight in grams from the internal examination.

cause_of_death.description: Primary cause as stated in the Anatomic Summary / Cause of Death section.

manner_of_death.description: Manner of death as classified by the examiner.

anatomic_findings.description: Every distinct numbered/lettered finding from the Anatomic Summary (I.A, I.B, II.A, ...).

toxicology_results.description: Every row of the toxicology table — one entry per (substance, specimen) pair with its analytical result.

result.description: Quantitative result as printed, or 'Negative' / 'Not Detected'.

positive_toxicology_substances.description: Set of substances with a non-zero / non-negative toxicology finding across any specimen. Derived — requires filtering the toxicology_results table.

external_injuries_diagram_findings.description: Labels annotated on the body diagram figure (page with the body silhouette). Empty array if no annotations.

annotation.description: Text or description of the injury/marking.

has_signs_of_fatal_trauma.description: Whether the Anatomic Summary indicates signs of fatal trauma. Computed from the summary statement.

supplementary_reports_referenced.description: Separate reports referenced by the autopsy (e.g., microscopic, toxicology, microbiology).

age_at_death_years.description: Age of the decedent at death, computed from decedent DOB and date of death. Requires date arithmetic across two fields in different parts of the report.

days_from_death_to_autopsy.description: Whole days between date_of_death and date_of_autopsy. Null if either date is missing.

heart_weight_meets_cardiomegaly_threshol.description: Whether the recorded heart_weight_grams exceeds the typical male-adult cardiomegaly threshold (~400g). Requires combining extracted weight with external medical knowledge.

negative_toxicology_count.description: Count of toxicology table rows whose result is 'Negative', 'Not Detected', or equivalent. Derived by filtering toxicology_results.

highest_ketamine_specimen.description: If ketamine is detected in any specimen, the specimen name with the highest recorded concentration. Null if ketamine not detected. Cross-row reasoning on the toxicology table.

anatomic_findings_count_involving_cardia.description: Count of entries in anatomic_findings that describe cardiac findings (heart, coronary, aortic, myocardium). Requires semantic filtering of the summary.

manner_consistent_with_accident.description: Whether the anatomic findings + toxicology profile are collectively consistent with manner_of_death='accident'. Compositional reasoning across the full report.

foul_play_language_present.description: Whether the Anatomic Summary explicitly states no foul play suspected (or similar). Tests form-region detection in the summary.

handwritten_annotations_on_body_diagram.description: Whether the body silhouette figure contains handwritten annotations (not just printed labels). Requires classifying marks on the figure as hand-drawn.

autopsy_report_header_form.description: The boxed autopsy-report header form found at the top of most pages: case number, decedent name, DOB, sex, ethnicity, date of death, date of exam, examining pathologist. Tests dense boxed form-region KV binding.

toxicology_table_header_row.description: Ordered column headers of the toxicology results table exactly as printed. Tests header-row extraction on a multi-column analytical table.

toxicology_specimens_tested.description: Unique specimen types referenced in the toxicology tables (e.g. 'Heart Blood', 'Vitreous Humor', 'Liver'). Requires set-wise aggregation across multiple test rows.

external_examination_checklist_items_mar.description: Count of items checked or marked present on the external examination form region (not counting unmarked checkbox items). Tests checkbox density read on a dense boxed form region.

supplementary_reports_header_fields.description: For the toxicology supplementary report header: patient ID, account number, date collected, date received. A dense KV header on a separate report page.
